Class KfeInboundSettlementService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.paymentexecution.adapters.out.settlement.KfeInboundSettlementService
@Service public class KfeInboundSettlementService extends Object
Verifies inbound settlement decisions and applies ledger, audit, statement, outbox, and notification effects atomically.

  • Method Details

    • settle

      @Transactional public boolean settle(KfeInboundSettlementService.InboundSettlementProof proof)
      Validates proof identity and domain binding under ordered reference/outbox/transaction locks, then applies an idempotent credit and all financial projections in one transaction.
      Parameters:
      proof - provider/network evidence to evaluate
      Returns:
      true when settlement was newly applied or already applied; false when evidence is invalid, incomplete, below finality, or requires reconciliation
